flow_id.description: Informational only: inside a running flow the active flow's own id (from the run's trusted origin) is authoritative and this value is ignored. This tool ONLY works inside a workflow run — calling it from chat or any other context without a trusted run origin is refused, regardless of what is passed here.

key.description: Unique key for this memory within the flow's own memory

category.description: What kind of statement this is: 'fact' (default), 'preference', 'procedure', 'correction', or anything else (stored as 'other').
